OFFICE MEMORANDUM
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Sri Ganganagar
Date: 27 May 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/234)
Subject: Monthly Stock Audit of Essential Medicines under Free Drug Distribution Scheme (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Sri Ganganagar division are hereby informed that under 'Monthly Stock Audit of Essential Medicines under Free Drug Distribution Scheme', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 12 May in the central portal wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #334) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Sri Ganganagar, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and portal movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Sri Ganganagar), 2. Budget Reconciliation #144, 3. Digital Indexing.
Chief Accounts Officer
Pooja Kumawat
solution_steps: 2. Click Align Left, Underline, and Shading.
